all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلۡ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنۡ أَرَادَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلۡ هُنَّ كَٰشِفَٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوۡ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحۡمَةٍ هَلۡ هُنَّ مُمۡسِكَٰتُ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ قُلۡ حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُۖ عَلَيۡهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلُونَ

translations.saheeh: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allah? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."
translations.pickthall: And verily, if thou shouldst ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth? they will say: Allah. Say: Bethink you then of those ye worship beside Allah, if Allah willed some hurt for me, could they remove from me His hurt; or if He willed some mercy for me, could they restrain His mercy? Say: Allah is my all. In Him do (all) the trusting put their trust.
translations.khattab: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “Allah!” Ask ˹them˺, “Consider then whatever ˹idols˺ you invoke besides Allah: if it was Allah’s Will to harm me, could they undo that harm? Or if He willed ˹some˺ mercy for me, could they withhold His mercy?” Say, “Allah is sufficient for me. In Him ˹alone˺ the faithful put their trust.”
translations.arberry: If thou askest them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' they will say, 'God.' Say: 'What think you? That you call upon apart from God -- if God desires affliction for me, shall they remove His affliction? Or if He desires mercy for me, shall they withhold His mercy?' Say: 'God is enough for me; in Him all those put their trust who put their trust.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ وَكِيلࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.
translations.pickthall: Allah is Creator of all things, and He is Guardian over all things.
translations.khattab: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is the Maintainer of everything
translations.arberry: God is the Creator of every thing; He is Guardian over every thing;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَخَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ خَلۡقِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

translations.saheeh: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know.
translations.pickthall: Assuredly the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of mankind; but most of mankind know not.
translations.khattab: The creation of the heavens and the earth is certainly greater than the re-creation of humankind, but most people do not know
translations.arberry: Certainly the creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of men; but most men know it not.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَخَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ خَلۡقِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

translations.saheeh: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know.
translations.pickthall: Assuredly the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of mankind; but most of mankind know not.
translations.khattab: The creation of the heavens and the earth is certainly greater than the re-creation of humankind, but most people do not know
translations.arberry: Certainly the creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of men; but most men know it not.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤۡفَكُونَ

translations.saheeh: That is Allah, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?
translations.pickthall: Such is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things, There is no Allah save Him. How then are ye perverted?
translations.khattab: That is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. How can you then be deluded ˹from the truth˺
translations.arberry: That then is God, your Lord, the Creator of everything; there is no god but He. How then are you perverted?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابࣲ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطۡفَةࣲ ثُمَّ مِنۡ عَلَقَةࣲ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُكُمۡ طِفۡلࣰ ا ثُمَّ لِتَبۡلُغُوٓاْ أَشُدَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُواْ شُيُوخࣰ اۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَلِتَبۡلُغُوٓاْ أَجَلࣰ ا مُّسَمࣰّ ى وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ

translations.saheeh: It is He who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child; then [He develops you] that you reach your [time of] maturity, then [further] that you become elders. And among you is he who is taken in death before [that], so that you reach a specified term; and perhaps you will use reason.
translations.pickthall: He it is Who created you from dust, then from a drop (of seed) then from a clot, then bringeth you forth as a child, then (ordaineth) that ye attain full strength and afterward that ye become old men - though some among you die before - and that ye reach an appointed term, that haply ye may understand.
translations.khattab: He is the One Who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then ˹developed you into˺ a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then He brings you forth as infants, so that you may reach your prime, and become old—though some of you ˹may˺ die sooner—reaching an appointed time, so perhaps you may understand ˹Allah’s power˺
translations.arberry: It is He who created you of dust then of a sperm-drop, then of a blood-clot, then He delivers you as infants, then that you may come of age, then that you may be old men -- though some of you there are who die before it -- and that you may reach a stated term; haply you will understand.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ۞قُلۡ أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَكۡفُرُونَ بِٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي يَوۡمَيۡنِ وَتَجۡعَلُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.saheeh: Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."
translations.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the idolaters): Disbelieve ye verily in Him Who created the earth in two Days, and ascribe ye unto Him rivals? He (and none else) is the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.khattab: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “How can you disbelieve in the One Who created the earth in two Days? And how can you set up equals with Him? That is the Lord of all worlds
translations.arberry: Say: 'What, do you disbelieve in Him who created the earth in two days, and do you set up compeers to Him? That is the Lord of all Being.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادࣱ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَقَالُواْ مَنۡ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةًۖ أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَهُمۡ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةࣰۖ وَكَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُونَ

translations.saheeh: As for 'Aad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allah who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs.
translations.pickthall: As for A'ad, they were arrogant in the land without right, and they said: Who is mightier than us in power? Could they not see that Allah Who created them, He was mightier than them in power? And they denied Our revelations.
translations.khattab: As for ’Ȃd, they acted arrogantly throughout the land with no right, boasting, “Who is superior to us in might?” Did they not see that Allah ˹Himself˺, Who created them, was far superior to them in might? Still they persisted in denying Our signs
translations.arberry: As for Ad, they waxed proud in the earth without right, and they said, 'Who is stronger than we in might?' What, did they not see that God, who created them, was stronger than they in might? And they denied Our signs.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَقَالُواْ لِجُلُودِهِمۡ لِمَ شَهِدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡنَاۖ قَالُوٓاْ أَنطَقَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءࣲۚ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةࣲ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

translations.saheeh: And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allah, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned.
translations.pickthall: And they say unto their skins: Why testify ye against us? They say: Allah hath given us speech Who giveth speech to all things, and Who created you at the first, and unto Whom ye are returned.
translations.khattab: They will ask their skin ˹furiously˺, “Why have you testified against us?” It will say, “We have been made to speak by Allah, Who causes all things to speak. He ˹is the One Who˺ created you the first time, and to Him you were bound to return
translations.arberry: and they will say to their skins, 'Why bore you witness against us?' They shall say, 'God gave us speech, as He gave everything speech. He created you the first time, and unto Him you shall be returned.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلَّيۡلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ وَٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُۚ لَا تَسۡجُدُواْ لِلشَّمۡسِ وَلَا لِلۡقَمَرِ وَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِۤ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمۡ إِيَّاهُ تَعۡبُدُونَ

translations.saheeh: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostate to Allah, who created them, if it should be Him that you worship.
translations.pickthall: And of His portents are the night and the day and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or the moon; but prostrate to Allah Who created them, if it is in truth Him Whom ye worship.
translations.khattab: Among His signs are the day and the night, the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or the moon, but prostrate to Allah, Who created them ˹all˺, if you ˹truly˺ worship Him ˹alone˺
translations.arberry: And of His signs are the night and the day, the sun and the moon. Bow not yourselves to the sun and moon, but bow yourselves to God who created them, if Him you serve.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةࣲۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمۡعِهِمۡ إِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: And of his signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent.
translations.pickthall: And of His portents is the creation of the heaven and the earth, and of whatever beasts He hath dispersed therein. And He is Able to gather them when He will.
translations.khattab: And among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and all living beings He dispersed throughout both. And He is Most Capable of bringing all together whenever He wills
translations.arberry: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and the crawling things He has scattered abroad in them; and He is able to gather them whenever He will.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لِّلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَٰثࣰ ا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ

translations.saheeh: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what he wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.
translations.pickthall: Unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He createth what He will. He bestoweth female (offspring) upon whom He will, and bestoweth male (offspring) upon whom He will;
translations.khattab: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He creates whatever He wills. He blesses whoever He wills with daughters, and blesses whoever He wills with sons
translations.arberry: To God belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He will; He gives to whom He will females, and He gives to whom He will males

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

translations.saheeh: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing."
translations.pickthall: And if thou (Muhammad) ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely answer: The Mighty, the Knower created them;
translations.khattab: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “The Almighty, All-Knowing did.”
translations.arberry: If thou askest them, 'Who created the heavens and earth?' they will say, 'The All-mighty, the All-knowing created them.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

translations.saheeh: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing."
translations.pickthall: And if thou (Muhammad) ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely answer: The Mighty, the Knower created them;
translations.khattab: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “The Almighty, All-Knowing did.”
translations.arberry: If thou askest them, 'Who created the heavens and earth?' they will say, 'The All-mighty, the All-knowing created them.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ مَا تَرۡكَبُونَ

translations.saheeh: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount.
translations.pickthall: He Who created all the pairs, and appointed for you ships and cattle whereupon ye ride.
translations.khattab: And ˹He is the One˺ Who created all ˹things in˺ pairs, and made for you ships and animals to ride
translations.arberry: and who created the pairs, all of them, and appointed for you ships and cattle such as you ride,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنَاتࣲ وَأَصۡفَىٰكُم بِٱلۡبَنِينَ

translations.saheeh: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
translations.pickthall: Or chooseth He daughters of all that He hath created, and honoureth He you with sons?
translations.khattab: Has He taken ˹angels as His˺ daughters from what He created, and favoured you ˹O pagans˺ with sons
translations.arberry: Or has He taken to Himself, from that He creates, daughters, and favoured you with sons?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًاۚ أَشَهِدُواْ خَلۡقَهُمۡۚ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔلُونَ

translations.saheeh: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
translations.pickthall: And they make the angels, who are the slaves of the Beneficent, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded and they will be questioned.
translations.khattab: Still they have labelled the angels, who are servants of the Most Compassionate, as female. Did they witness their creation? Their statement will be recorded, and they will be questioned
translations.arberry: And they have made the angels, who are themselves servants of the All-merciful, females. What, did they witness their creation? Their witness shall be written down, and they shall be questioned.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ

translations.saheeh: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded?
translations.pickthall: And if thou ask them who created them, they will surely say: Allah. How then are they turned away?
translations.khattab: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created them, they will certainly say, “Allah!” How can they then be deluded ˹from the truth˺
translations.arberry: If thou askest them, 'Who created you?' they will say, 'God.' How then are they perverted?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ

translations.saheeh: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
translations.pickthall: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.
translations.khattab: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport
translations.arberry: We created not the heavens and earth, and all that between them is, in play;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

translations.saheeh: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
translations.pickthall: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.
translations.khattab: We only created them for a purpose, but most of these ˹pagans˺ do not know
translations.arberry: We created them not save in truth; but most of them know it not.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَفِي خَلۡقِكُمۡ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتࣱ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يُوقِنُونَ

translations.saheeh: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
translations.pickthall: And in your creation, and all the beasts that He scattereth in the earth, are portents for a folk whose faith is sure.
translations.khattab: And in your own creation, and whatever living beings He dispersed, are signs for people of sure faith
translations.arberry: and in your creation, and the crawling things He scatters abroad, there are signs for a people having sure faith,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ

translations.saheeh: And Allah created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
translations.pickthall: And Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth, and that every soul may be repaid what it hath earned. And they will not be wronged.
translations.khattab: For Allah created the heavens and the earth for a purpose, so that every soul may be paid back for what it has committed. And none will be wronged
translations.arberry: God created the heavens and the earth in truth, and that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned; they shall not be wronged.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَجَلࣲ مُّسَمࣰّ ىۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُواْ مُعۡرِضُونَ

translations.saheeh: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
translations.pickthall: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and for a term appointed. But those who disbelieve turn away from that whereof they are warned.
translations.khattab: We only created the heavens and the earth and everything in between for a purpose and an appointed term. Yet the disbelievers are turning away from what they have been warned about
translations.arberry: We have not created the heavens and the earth, and what between them is, save with the truth and a stated term; but the unbelievers are turning away from that they were warned of.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شِرۡكࣱ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِۖ ٱئۡتُونِي بِكِتَٰبࣲ مِّن قَبۡلِ هَٰذَآ أَوۡ أَثَٰرَةࣲ مِّنۡ عِلۡمٍ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

translations.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."
translations.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Have ye thought on all that ye invoke beside Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth. Or have they any portion in the heavens? Bring me a scripture before this (Scripture), or some vestige of knowledge (in support of what ye say), if ye are truthful.
translations.khattab: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “Have you considered whatever ˹idols˺ you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created on earth! Or do they have a share in ˹the creation of˺ the heavens? Bring me a scripture ˹revealed˺ before this ˹Quran˺ or a shred of knowledge, if what you say is true.”
translations.arberry: Say: 'Have you considered that you call upon apart from God? Show me what they have created of the earth; or have they a partnership in the heavens? Bring me a Book before this, or some remnant of a knowledge, if you speak truly.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَمۡ يَعۡيَ بِخَلۡقِهِنَّ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰۚ بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent.
translations.pickthall: Have they not seen that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth and was not wearied by their creation, is Able to give life to the dead? Aye, He verily is Able to do all things.
translations.khattab: Do they not realize that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth and did not tire in creating them, is able to give life to the dead? Yes ˹indeed˺! He is certainly Most Capable of everything
translations.arberry: What, have they not seen that God who created the heavens and earth, not being wearied by creating them, is able to give life to the dead? Yes indeed; He is powerful over everything.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَمۡ يَعۡيَ بِخَلۡقِهِنَّ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰۚ بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent.
translations.pickthall: Have they not seen that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth and was not wearied by their creation, is Able to give life to the dead? Aye, He verily is Able to do all things.
translations.khattab: Do they not realize that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth and did not tire in creating them, is able to give life to the dead? Yes ˹indeed˺! He is certainly Most Capable of everything
translations.arberry: What, have they not seen that God who created the heavens and earth, not being wearied by creating them, is able to give life to the dead? Yes indeed; He is powerful over everything.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرࣲ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلۡنَٰكُمۡ شُعُوبࣰ ا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ أَكۡرَمَكُمۡ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتۡقَىٰكُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Acquainted.
translations.pickthall: O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that ye may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.
translations.khattab: O humanity! Indeed, We created you from a male and a female, and made you into peoples and tribes so that you may ˹get to˺ know one another. Surely the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous among you. Allah is truly All-Knowing, All-Aware
translations.arberry: O mankind, We have created you male and female, and appointed you races and tribes, that you may know one another. Surely the noblest among you in the sight of God is the most godfearing of you. God is All-knowing, All-aware.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلۡخَلۡقِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي لَبۡسࣲ مِّنۡ خَلۡقࣲ جَدِيدࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
translations.pickthall: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.
translations.khattab: Were We incapable of creating ˹them˺ the first time? In fact, they are in doubt about ˹their˺ re-creation
translations.arberry: What, were We wearied by the first creation? No indeed; but they are in uncertainty as to the new creation.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلۡخَلۡقِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي لَبۡسࣲ مِّنۡ خَلۡقࣲ جَدِيدࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
translations.pickthall: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.
translations.khattab: Were We incapable of creating ˹them˺ the first time? In fact, they are in doubt about ˹their˺ re-creation
translations.arberry: What, were We wearied by the first creation? No indeed; but they are in uncertainty as to the new creation.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعۡلَمُ مَا تُوَسۡوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفۡسُهُۥۖ وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ حَبۡلِ ٱلۡوَرِيدِ

translations.saheeh: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
translations.pickthall: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
translations.khattab: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ created humankind and ˹fully˺ know what their souls whisper to them, and We are closer to them than ˹their˺ jugular vein
translations.arberry: We indeed created man; and We know what his soul whispers within him, and We are nearer to him than the jugular vein.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
translations.pickthall: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.
translations.khattab: Indeed, We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, and We were not ˹even˺ touched with fatigue
translations.arberry: We created the heavens and the earth, and what between them is, in six days, and no weariness touched Us.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.saheeh: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.
translations.pickthall: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.
translations.khattab: And We created pairs of all things so perhaps you would be mindful
translations.arberry: And of everything created We two kinds; haply you will remember.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ

translations.saheeh: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
translations.pickthall: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.
translations.khattab: I did not create jinn and humans except to worship Me
translations.arberry: I have not created jinn and mankind except to serve Me.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ

translations.saheeh: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
translations.pickthall: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?
translations.khattab: Or were they created by nothing, or are they ˹their own˺ creators
translations.arberry: Or were they created out of nothing? Or are they the creators?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ

translations.saheeh: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
translations.pickthall: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?
translations.khattab: Or were they created by nothing, or are they ˹their own˺ creators
translations.arberry: Or were they created out of nothing? Or are they the creators?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ

translations.saheeh: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
translations.pickthall: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!
translations.khattab: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no firm belief ˹in Allah˺
translations.arberry: Or did they create the heavens and earth? Nay, but they have not sure faith.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰ

translations.saheeh: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
translations.pickthall: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,
translations.khattab: And He created the pairs—males and females—
translations.arberry: and that He Himself created the two kinds, male and female,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
translations.pickthall: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.
translations.khattab: Indeed, We have created everything, perfectly preordained
translations.arberry: Surely We have created everything in measure.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ

translations.saheeh: Created man,
translations.pickthall: He hath created man.
translations.khattab: created humanity
translations.arberry: He created man

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلࣲ كَٱلۡفَخَّارِ

translations.saheeh: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
translations.pickthall: He created man of clay like the potter's,
translations.khattab: He created humankind from ˹sounding˺ clay like pottery
translations.arberry: He created man of a clay like the potter's,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱلۡجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجࣲ مِّن نَّارࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
translations.pickthall: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.
translations.khattab: and created jinn from a ˹smokeless˺ flame of fire
translations.arberry: and He created the jinn of a smokeless fire.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: نَحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ فَلَوۡلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ

translations.saheeh: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
translations.pickthall: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?
translations.khattab: It is We Who created you. Will you not then believe ˹in resurrection˺
translations.arberry: We created you; therefore why will you not believe?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ تَخۡلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ

translations.saheeh: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
translations.pickthall: Do ye create it or are We the Creator?
translations.khattab: Is it you who create ˹a child out of˺ it, or is it We Who do so
translations.arberry: Do you yourselves create it, or are We the Creators?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ تَخۡلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ

translations.saheeh: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
translations.pickthall: Do ye create it or are We the Creator?
translations.khattab: Is it you who create ˹a child out of˺ it, or is it We Who do so
translations.arberry: Do you yourselves create it, or are We the Creators?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعۡرُجُ فِيهَاۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing.
translations.pickthall: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
translations.khattab: He is the One Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, then established Himself on the Throne. He knows whatever goes into the earth and whatever comes out of it, and whatever descends from the sky and whatever ascends into it. And He is with you wherever you are. For Allah is All-Seeing of what you do
translations.arberry: It is He that created the heavens and the earth in six days then seated Himself upon the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth, and what comes forth from it, -- what comes down from heaven, and what goes up unto it. He is with you wherever you are; and God sees the things you do.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُ ٱلۡبَارِئُ ٱلۡمُصَوِّرُۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

translations.saheeh: He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translations.pickthall: He is Allah, the Creator, the Shaper out of naught, the Fashioner. His are the most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
translations.khattab: He is Allah: the Creator, the Inventor, the Shaper. He ˹alone˺ has the Most Beautiful Names. Whatever is in the heavens and the earth ˹constantly˺ glorifies Him. And He is the Almighty, All-Wise
translations.arberry: He is God, the Creator, the Maker, the Shaper. To Him belong the Names Most Beautiful. All that is in the heavens and the earth magnifies Him; He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ فَمِنكُمۡ كَافِرࣱ وَمِنكُم مُّؤۡمِنࣱۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

translations.saheeh: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing.
translations.pickthall: He it is Who created you, but one of you is a disbeliever and one of you is a believer, and Allah is Seer of what ye do.
translations.khattab: He is the One Who created you, yet some of you are disbelievers while some are believers. And Allah is All-Seeing of what you do
translations.arberry: It is He who created you. One of you is an unbeliever, and one of you a believer; and God sees the things you do.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمۡ فَأَحۡسَنَ صُوَرَكُمۡۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

translations.saheeh: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.
translations.pickthall: He created the heavens and the earth with truth, and He shaped you and made good your shapes, and unto Him is the journeying.
translations.khattab: He created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. He shaped you ˹in the womb˺, perfecting your form. And to Him is the final return
translations.arberry: He created the heavens and the earth with the truth, and He shaped you, and shaped you well; and unto Him is the homecoming.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِثۡلَهُنَّۖ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ بَيۡنَهُنَّ لِتَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمَۢا

translations.saheeh: It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge.
translations.pickthall: Allah it is who hath created seven heavens, and of the earth the like thereof. The commandment cometh down among them slowly, that ye may know that Allah is Able to do all things, and that Allah surroundeth all things in knowledge.
translations.khattab: Allah is the One Who created seven heavens ˹in layers˺, and likewise for the earth. The ˹divine˺ command descends between them so you may know that Allah is Most Capable of everything and that Allah certainly encompasses all things in ˹His˺ knowledge
translations.arberry: It is God who created seven heavens, and of earth their like, between them the Command descending, that you may know that God is powerful over everything and that God encompasses everything in knowledge.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلࣰ اۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفُورُ

translations.saheeh: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
translations.pickthall: Who hath created life and death that He may try you which of you is best in conduct; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving,
translations.khattab: ˹He is the One˺ Who created death and life in order to test which of you is best in deeds. And He is the Almighty, All-Forgiving
translations.arberry: who created death and life, that He might try you which of you is fairest in works; and He is the All-mighty, the All-forgiving --

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقࣰ اۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتࣲۖ فَٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ هَلۡ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
translations.pickthall: Who hath created seven heavens in harmony. Thou (Muhammad) canst see no fault in the Beneficent One's creation; then look again: Canst thou see any rifts?
translations.khattab: ˹He is the One˺ Who created seven heavens, one above the other. You will never see any imperfection in the creation of the Most Compassionate. So look again: do you see any flaws
translations.arberry: who created seven heavens one upon another. Thou seest not in the creation of the All-merciful any imperfection. Return thy gaze; seest thou any fissure?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقࣰ اۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتࣲۖ فَٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ هَلۡ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
translations.pickthall: Who hath created seven heavens in harmony. Thou (Muhammad) canst see no fault in the Beneficent One's creation; then look again: Canst thou see any rifts?
translations.khattab: ˹He is the One˺ Who created seven heavens, one above the other. You will never see any imperfection in the creation of the Most Compassionate. So look again: do you see any flaws
translations.arberry: who created seven heavens one upon another. Thou seest not in the creation of the All-merciful any imperfection. Return thy gaze; seest thou any fissure?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ

translations.saheeh: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?
translations.pickthall: Should He not know what He created? And He is the Subtile, the Aware.
translations.khattab: How could He not know His Own creation? For He ˹alone˺ is the Most Subtle, All-Aware
translations.arberry: Shall He not know, who created? And He is the All-subtle, the All-aware.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
translations.pickthall: And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature.
translations.khattab: And you are truly ˹a man˺ of outstanding character
translations.arberry: surely thou art upon a mighty morality.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ۞إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا

translations.saheeh: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
translations.pickthall: Lo! man was created anxious,
translations.khattab: Indeed, humankind was created impatient
translations.arberry: Surely man was created fretful,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: كَلَّآۖ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعۡلَمُونَ

translations.saheeh: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
translations.pickthall: Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know.
translations.khattab: But no! Indeed, they ˹already˺ know what We created them from
translations.arberry: Not so; for We have created them of what they know.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَطۡوَارًا

translations.saheeh: While He has created you in stages?
translations.pickthall: When He created you by (divers) stages?
translations.khattab: when He truly created you in stages ˹of development˺
translations.arberry: seeing He created you by stages?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
translations.pickthall: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,
translations.khattab: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other
translations.arberry: Have you not regarded how God created seven heavens one upon another,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ذَرۡنِي وَمَنۡ خَلَقۡتُ وَحِيدࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Leave Me with the one I created alone
translations.pickthall: Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely,
translations.khattab: And leave to me ˹O Prophet˺ the one I created all by Myself
translations.arberry: Leave Me with him whom I created alone,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةࣰ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

translations.saheeh: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
translations.pickthall: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned
translations.khattab: Then they became a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then He developed and perfected their form
translations.arberry: Then he was a blood-clot, and He created and formed,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ أَمۡشَاجࣲ نَّبۡتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرًا

translations.saheeh: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
translations.pickthall: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.
translations.khattab: ˹For˺ indeed, We ˹alone˺ created humans from a drop of mixed fluids, ˹in order˺ to test them, so We made them hear and see
translations.arberry: We created man of a sperm-drop, a mingling, and We made him hearing, seeing.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: نَّحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَآ أَسۡرَهُمۡۖ وَإِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَآ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ تَبۡدِيلًا

translations.saheeh: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
translations.pickthall: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.
translations.khattab: It is We Who created them and perfected their ˹physical˺ form. But if We will, We can easily replace them with others
translations.arberry: We created them, and We strengthened their joints; and, when We will, We shall exchange their likes.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَلَمۡ نَخۡلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءࣲ مَّهِينࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
translations.pickthall: Did We not create you from a base fluid
translations.khattab: Did We not create you from a humble fluid
translations.arberry: Did We not create you of a mean water,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَخَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And We created you in pairs
translations.pickthall: And We have created you in pairs,
translations.khattab: and created you in pairs
translations.arberry: And We created you in pairs,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا

translations.saheeh: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
translations.pickthall: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?
translations.khattab: Which is harder to create: you or the sky? He built it
translations.arberry: What, are you stronger in constitution or the heaven He built?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مِنۡ أَيِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ

translations.saheeh: From what substance did He create him?
translations.pickthall: From what thing doth He create him?
translations.khattab: From what substance did He create them
translations.arberry: Of what did He create him?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ

translations.saheeh: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
translations.pickthall: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,
translations.khattab: He created them from a sperm-drop, and ordained their development
translations.arberry: Of a sperm-drop He created him, and determined him,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ

translations.saheeh: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
translations.pickthall: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?
translations.khattab: Who created you, fashioned you, and perfected your design
translations.arberry: who created thee and shaped thee and wrought thee in symmetry

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ

translations.saheeh: So let man observe from what he was created.
translations.pickthall: So let man consider from what he is created.
translations.khattab: Let people then consider what they were created from
translations.arberry: So let man consider of what he was created;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءࣲ دَافِقࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
translations.pickthall: He is created from a gushing fluid
translations.khattab: ˹They were˺ created from a spurting fluid
translations.arberry: he was created of gushing water

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

translations.saheeh: Who created and proportioned
translations.pickthall: Who createth, then disposeth;
translations.khattab: Who created and ˹perfectly˺ fashioned ˹all˺
translations.arberry: who created and shaped,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡ

translations.saheeh: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
translations.pickthall: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?
translations.khattab: Do they not ever reflect on camels—how they were ˹masterfully˺ created
translations.arberry: What, do they not consider how the camel was created,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ

translations.saheeh: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
translations.pickthall: The like of which was not created in the lands;
translations.khattab: unmatched in any other land
translations.arberry: the like of which was never created in the land,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِي كَبَدٍ

translations.saheeh: We have certainly created man into hardship.
translations.pickthall: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:
translations.khattab: Indeed, We have created humankind in ˹constant˺ struggle
translations.arberry: indeed, We created man in trouble.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: And [by] He who created the male and female,
translations.pickthall: And Him Who hath created male and female,
translations.khattab: And by ˹the One˺ Who created male and female
translations.arberry: and That which created the male and the female,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
translations.pickthall: Surely We created man of the best stature
translations.khattab: Indeed, We created humans in the best form
translations.arberry: We indeed created Man in the fairest stature

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱقۡرَأۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ

translations.saheeh: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
translations.pickthall: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,
translations.khattab: Read, ˹O Prophet,˺ in the Name of your Lord Who created—
translations.arberry: Recite: In the Name of thy Lord who created,

translations.saheeh: Created man from a clinging substance.
translations.pickthall: Createth man from a clot.
translations.khattab: created humans from a clinging clot
translations.arberry: created Man of a blood-clot.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

translations.arberry: from the evil of what He has created,
